# A Creative Block

A Creative Block is a creative coaching and consulting practice for artists, creatives and teams whose meaningful work has stopped moving. We use research as a lens—not a script—to understand the mechanism behind a block and choose a practical response.

## Scope
A Creative Block offers coaching and collaborative creative consulting. It is not psychotherapy, medical care or universal specialist expertise across every creative discipline. Where a clinical concern or specialist skill is the real need, we say so and recommend appropriate support.
